podcast.body: This song became the first accidental hidden track in music history, appearing at the very end of the "Abbey Road" album after 20 seconds of silence. Initially, Paul McCartney had requested its removal, but tape assistant John Kerlander, following studio rules, spliced it to the end of the master tape with a gap, a note for the mastering engineer that was either unread or misunderstood, leading to its unexpected inclusion which the band approved upon hearing. "Paul McCartney, he said, great, but you know, take that last track, a song called Her Majesty Out. It just doesn't work. Just drop it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
